title: EffectLimits
description: Declared amount/effect limits. v1.0 accepts any shape here; the v1.1 consumption profile additionally requires, for effectful non-blocked actions, a non-null max_amount and a non-empty unit (or max_amount 0 as an explicit non-monetary mode); see the $defs/effect_limits_v1_1 rule in agent_action_manifest.schema.json and validator code E023.
